svg.title: B-spline Policy training
svg.desc: Each demonstration is fitted with a cubic B-spline by inserting knots where the error is largest until it is below a tolerance; knots cluster where the motion bends. At each observation the target is the next 16 knots and their control points, which cover a long time where the motion is simple and a short time where it is detailed. A Diffusion Policy UNet learns to denoise them. A looser tolerance compresses more with little change in score (Push-T, Table 3).
svg.text: BSP learns the curve behind each demonstration.

g.text: KNOTS · DENSE WHERE IT IS FINE

svg.text: source · Han, Xiong et al. 2026, B-spline Policy (arXiv 2607.09648), Alg. 1, App. A.1, Table 3 · toy joint trajectory
